title: In the Wild
intro: Wild animals live in forests and jungles!

parentTip.vi: Đố con bằng định nghĩa rồi đổi vai: "This bird has got big eyes and flies at night. What is it?"
parentTip.say: Which wild animal do you like?

chat.ask: Have you ever seen a fox?
chat.no: Maybe one day in the countryside!

gaps.s: The ___ has got big eyes and flies at night.
The ___ is the biggest, strongest animal in the jungle.

text.title: A Night in the Forest
lines: Last summer, we went camping in a forest.
At night, we heard an owl in the trees.
In the morning, Dad saw a fox near our tent.
There aren't any wolves in this forest, so we weren't afraid!

questions.q: What did they hear at night?
What did Dad see in the morning?
